title: Favorite tunes: Melancholy Baby, It Had to Be You
summary: Leclerc likes sentimental songs and names Melancholy Baby and It Had to Be You as favorites.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Yeah, well, maybe just Maple Leaf and Triangle. Yeah, Triangle Blues. You want to play Purple Rose or Cairo, you can. Whatever you want to play. Yeah, yeah. You know, I think what's your favorite tune of all? Well, none really. I remember one time we went over to the music school and you played Melancholy Baby for me, I think it was.

Oh, yeah, that's one of my favorites. It made me think of it. Yeah, that's one of my favorites. Melancholy Baby, yeah. I like that. Lots of times I chose the piano to play that. What's that other number? It Had to Be You. I like that.
